proposed.code_citation: RA 9266 IRR Sections 3(2), 20, and 32; Civil Code Article 1723
proposed.explanation: RA 9266 separates the AOR design-document role from the AiCC construction-supervision role; risk management starts with documenting which duties the architect actually accepts.
proposed.text: How should an architect manage responsibility when the facts may involve both Architect-of-Record and Architect-in-Charge of Construction duties?

options.text: Treat the two role labels as interchangeable once construction begins
Define and document whether the architect is accepting design-document responsibility, construction-supervision responsibility, or both
Assume the contractor alone answers for all construction-stage defects
Assume the professional seal eliminates Article 1723 exposure
